entry.title: JN-106 0.2.0
entry.summary: Arpeggiator tempo sync (SYNC key + DIV slider, 1/1 to 1/32 with triplets); bigger touch areas on the rocker switches and keys; Perform knobs no longer show a square border; more room round the noise slider on LFO/DCO; MPC Q-Link column outlines. Q-Link columns are regrouped by panel section, so CC 20-35 map in a different order than 0.1.0. New parameters are appended, so saved projects load unchanged. **Install:** armv7 zip for Gen1 MPCs and the Force, aarch64 zip for Gen2; follow INSTALL.md in

entry.title: JN-106 0.1.0
entry.summary: Six-voice Juno-style polysynth (ultramaster_kr106 DSP) with 256 factory presets and a realistic panel skin. Tested on a Force (MPC OS 3.9.1); the aarch64 zip (Gen2) is untested. CPU on a Force: six held notes about 31% of a block at 2x oversampling (20% at 1x); a fast Q-Link sweep peaks at 47% at p99 (bench verdict FAIL). Use 1x oversampling (SETTINGS) and one instance on a busy project. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II
